title: worktrees.create reuses an existing worktrees/<role> checked out on another feature's branch
detail: prusik/worktrees.py:173 create() returns an existing worktrees/<role> dir after only recording a fork point; it never checks the checked-out branch is sprint/<feature>-<role>. Observed 2026-11-18: worktrees/backend-builder and test-writer were still on sprint/tiered-solo-builder-* (merged into main) when the observed-writes redo was about to start, so drive would have built observed-writes on another feature's branch and skipped the kept sprint/observed-writes-* work. Expected: refuse (or re-fork) when the worktree's branch is not branch_name(feature, role), naming both.
